dedupe_keys.name: ecam water utility energy and carbon assessment

description: ECAM is a browser application for water and wastewater utilities to assess energy use and greenhouse gas emissions. ICRA, IWA, GIZ and collaborators publish its source and instructions for online or local deployment. Users enter system-wide activity and energy information; outputs are emissions and energy summaries for the utility under study. Geographic coverage depends on the utility data entered, not a bundled national dataset. The README states free access and Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 licence terms for the code. A limitation is that reported totals depend on complete utility boundaries, measured electricity and process assumptions; the application does not simulate hydraulic performance or pipe failure. ECAM can supply energy and emissions parameters for water-infrastructure planning scenarios. The related catalogue EPANET model simulates water distribution hydraulics and is distinct. No utility input, web build or installer was downloaded.
